------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m4p0t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Techs, Units, MaxQueue

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES supply, inbox, holder, assigned, phase, done
vars == <<supply, inbox, holder, assigned, phase, done>>

Stages == {"idle", "claimed", "spinning", "settling"}

InboxSet == {inbox[i] : i \in 1 .. Len(inbox)}
AssignedUnits == {assigned[t] : t \in Techs} \ {NONE}

Init ==
    /\ supply = Units
    /\ inbox = << >>
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ assigned = [t \in Techs |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = [t \in Techs |-> "idle"]
    /\ done = {}

Enqueue(u) ==
    /\ u \in supply
    /\ Len(inbox) < MaxQueue
    /\ supply' = supply \ {u}
    /\ inbox' = Append(inbox, u)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, assigned, phase, done>>

Claim(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "idle"
    /\ inbox # << >>
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![t] = Head(inbox)]
    /\ inbox' = Tail(inbox)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "claimed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<supply, holder, done>>

Spin(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "claimed"
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ holder' = t
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "spinning"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<supply, inbox, assigned, done>>

Settle(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "spinning"
    /\ holder = t
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "settling"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<supply, inbox, holder, assigned, done>>

Finish(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "settling"
    /\ holder = t
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ done' = done \cup {assigned[t]}
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<supply, inbox>>

Restock(u) ==
    /\ u \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {u}
    /\ supply' = supply \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, holder, assigned, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Units : Enqueue(u) \/ Restock(u)
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Claim(t) \/ Spin(t) \/ Settle(t) \/ Finish(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ExclusiveHolder ==
    \A t \in Techs : (phase[t] \in {"spinning", "settling"}) <=> (holder = t)

UnitConservation ==
    supply \cup InboxSet \cup AssignedUnits \cup done = Units

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Techs = {t1, t2}
    Units = {u1, u2}
    MaxQueue = 2
INVARIANT ExclusiveHolder
INVARIANT UnitConservation
nl:
A regional blood-bank runs a single high-speed centrifuge that several lab technicians share to process donated blood units. Fresh donations arrive into a bounded intake queue; when the queue is full the intake desk applies backpressure and refuses new units until space frees up. An idle technician claims the unit at the head of the queue, then must acquire the one centrifuge before spinning it. Because the centrifuge is a critical shared resource, only the technician who currently holds it may spin, and while a spin is in progress no other technician may begin one. A technician can be slow but never fails: after spinning, the sample may need an extra settling pass on the same machine before the technician finishes, and during that settling step the technician still legitimately holds the centrifuge. Only when the technician finishes does the centrifuge become free again and the processed unit move to the completed set. To keep the bank running continuously, a restock step periodically returns a completed unit from the completed set back into the supply pool for re-crossmatching, so units recirculate through the pipeline. The intake queue is bounded, technicians move through the stages idle, claimed, spinning, settling, and back to idle, and the centrifuge holder is released exactly on finish.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every moment at most one technician is actively using the centrifuge, and that technician is exactly the recorded holder of the machine.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od8m0p0t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Students, MaxVersion

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES writer, version, phase, snap
vars == <<writer, version, phase, snap>>

Phases == {"idle", "reading", "committing"}

Init ==
    /\ writer = NONE
    /\ version = 0
    /\ phase = [s \in Students |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [s \in Students |-> 0]

Read(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "reading"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<writer, version>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "reading"
    /\ writer = NONE
    /\ snap[s] = version
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ writer' = s
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "committing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Retry(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "reading"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<writer, version, snap>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "committing"
    /\ writer = s
    /\ writer' = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap>>

AdminSeize(s) ==
    /\ writer = NONE
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ writer' = s
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "committing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Reset ==
    /\ version = MaxVersion
    /\ writer = NONE
    /\ \A s \in Students : phase[s] = "idle"
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<writer, phase, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : Read(s) \/ Commit(s) \/ Retry(s) \/ Release(s) \/ AdminSeize(s)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ExclusiveWriter ==
    \A s \in Students : (phase[s] = "committing") <=> (writer = s)

VersionMonotone ==
    version \in 0 .. MaxVersion

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Students = {s1, s2}
    MaxVersion = 3
INVARIANT ExclusiveWriter
INVARIANT VersionMonotone
nl:
A university course-registration system lets several students compete for exclusive write access to the enrollment ledger of a single popular section. Access is coordinated by optimistic locking: a student first reads the current ledger version into a private snapshot, then attempts to commit. A commit succeeds only if the ledger version still matches the snapshot the student read, at which point that student enters the committing state and holds exclusive write access to the ledger; the ledger records that student as its current writer and bumps its version. If another student changed the version in the meantime the commit fails and the student must retry, discarding the stale snapshot and reading again; a student may also abandon a read attempt at any time and return to idle before trying again. Because the ledger is a critical section, only the student the ledger records as writer may be in the committing state, and no two students may be committing at once. When a student is done writing it releases the ledger, clearing the writer slot so others can proceed. A privileged registrar admin may override the protocol at any time, seizing the writer slot directly and bumping the version, which forces any student holding a now-stale snapshot to retry.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every moment at most one student is in the committing state, and that student is exactly the writer the ledger currently records.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m3p0t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Engines, MaxEpoch, MaxBeat

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, phase, term, beat
vars == <<leader, epoch, phase, term, beat>>

Roles == {"follower", "candidate", "leading"}

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ phase = [n \in Engines |-> "follower"]
    /\ term = [n \in Engines |-> 0]
    /\ beat = 0

Nominate(n) ==
    /\ phase[n] = "follower"
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = epoch + 1]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![n] = "candidate"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, beat>>

Win(n) ==
    /\ phase[n] = "candidate"
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term[n] = epoch
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![n] = "leading"]
    /\ beat' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, term>>

Lose(n) ==
    /\ phase[n] = "candidate"
    /\ term[n] # epoch
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, term, beat>>

Heartbeat(n) ==
    /\ phase[n] = "leading"
    /\ leader = n
    /\ beat < MaxBeat
    /\ beat' = beat + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, phase, term>>

StepDown(n) ==
    /\ phase[n] = "leading"
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, term, beat>>

Reset ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ \A n \in Engines : phase[n] = "follower"
    /\ epoch' = 0
    /\ term' = [n \in Engines |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, phase, beat>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Engines : Nominate(n) \/ Win(n) \/ Lose(n) \/ Heartbeat(n) \/ StepDown(n)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SingleLeader ==
    \A n \in Engines : (phase[n] = "leading") <=> (leader = n)

EpochBounded ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ \A n \in Engines : term[n] \in 0 .. MaxEpoch

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Engines = {e1, e2}
    MaxEpoch = 3
    MaxBeat = 2
INVARIANT SingleLeader
INVARIANT EpochBounded
nl:
A stock exchange runs its opening auction on a cluster of matching engines, but only one engine at a time may act as the leader that owns the auction order book, which is the critical resource. Leadership is decided by epoch-numbered election with failover. A follower engine that wants to lead nominates itself by advancing the cluster epoch and recording its own term as that new epoch. A candidate wins and becomes the leader only when there is currently no leader and its recorded term still equals the cluster epoch, meaning no later nomination has superseded it; on winning, the cluster records it as the leader. An engine can be slow but never fails: the sitting leader periodically emits a heartbeat, and a slow leader simply emits heartbeats more lazily without ever losing liveness. Because leadership is exclusive, an engine is in the leading state exactly when the cluster records it as the leader, and no two engines lead at once. A leader hands off by voluntarily stepping down, which clears the recorded leader so a fresh election can occur. When the epoch reaches its ceiling and no leader sits, the cluster resets its epoch so the exchange can keep opening new sessions.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every moment at most one matching engine is in the leading state, and that engine is exactly the leader the cluster currently records.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m1p2t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, TotalDoses

Stations == 0 .. (N - 1)

VARIABLES token, vault, inHand, dispensed
vars == <<token, vault, inHand, dispensed>>

RECURSIVE SumHandOf(_)
SumHandOf(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
         IN inHand[x] + SumHandOf(S \ {x})

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ vault = TotalDoses
    /\ inHand = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
    /\ dispensed = 0

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, inHand, dispensed>>

Load(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ vault > 0
    /\ vault' = vault - 1
    /\ inHand' = [inHand EXCEPT ![n] = inHand[n] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, dispensed>>

Dispense(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ inHand[n] > 0
    /\ inHand' = [inHand EXCEPT ![n] = inHand[n] - 1]
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, vault>>

AdminReturn ==
    /\ dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ vault' = vault + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inHand>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ AdminReturn
    \/ \E n \in Stations : Load(n) \/ Dispense(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DoseConservation ==
    vault + SumHandOf(Stations) + dispensed = TotalDoses

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    N = 2
    TotalDoses = 2
INVARIANT DoseConservation
nl:
A hospital pharmacy dispenses controlled-substance doses from a ring of dispensing stations that share a single physical dispensing token, which circulates around the ring so that only the station currently holding the token may touch the drug supply. Doses are a conserved quantity: they begin locked in the central vault, and the only legal moves are to relocate an existing dose, never to create or destroy one. The token holder may load one dose from the vault into its own hand, or dispense one dose from its hand to a patient, which moves that dose into the dispensed tally. When it is done, the holder passes the token to the next station around the ring. A privileged pharmacy admin may override the ring to reconcile inventory by returning a previously dispensed dose back into the vault, for example after a cancelled administration, which recycles doses so the pharmacy keeps operating. Across all of these moves the grand total of doses in the vault, in station hands, and in the dispensed tally never changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of doses in the vault, in all station hands, and in the dispensed tally is always exactly the fixed total the pharmacy started with.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od9m0p2t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Operators, TotalDemand, MaxVersion

VARIABLES served, shed, version, snap, phase
vars == <<served, shed, version, snap, phase>>

Phases == {"idle", "reading"}

Init ==
    /\ served = TotalDemand
    /\ shed = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [o \in Operators |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [o \in Operators |-> "idle"]

Read(o) ==
    /\ phase[o] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![o] = "reading"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![o] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, shed, version>>

ShedOne(o) ==
    /\ phase[o] = "reading"
    /\ snap[o] = version
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ served > 0
    /\ served' = served - 1
    /\ shed' = shed + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![o] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

RestoreOne(o) ==
    /\ phase[o] = "reading"
    /\ snap[o] = version
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ shed > 0
    /\ shed' = shed - 1
    /\ served' = served + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![o] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Retry(o) ==
    /\ phase[o] = "reading"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![o] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, shed, version, snap>>

Refresh(o) ==
    /\ phase[o] = "reading"
    /\ snap[o] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![o] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, shed, version, phase>>

Reset ==
    /\ version = MaxVersion
    /\ \A o \in Operators : phase[o] = "idle"
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ snap' = [o \in Operators |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, shed, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ Reset
    \/ \E o \in Operators : Read(o) \/ ShedOne(o) \/ RestoreOne(o) \/ Retry(o) \/ Refresh(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DemandConservation ==
    served + shed = TotalDemand

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Operators = {o1, o2}
    TotalDemand = 2
    MaxVersion = 3
INVARIANT DemandConservation
nl:
A regional power-grid load shedder balances a fixed block of electrical demand between load that is currently served on the grid and load that has been deliberately shed to protect stability. Nothing is ever created or destroyed: every megawatt of demand is at all times either served or shed, so the two tallies always add up to the same fixed total. Several control operators adjust the split using optimistic locking against a shared allocation register that carries a version number. An operator first reads the current version into a private snapshot, then attempts an action; the action commits only if the version still matches the snapshot, otherwise the operator must retry. A commit either sheds one unit of served load, moving it from served to shed, or restores one previously shed unit back to served; either way the version advances. An operator can be slow but never fails: a slow operator may simply refresh its snapshot to the latest version before acting, without changing any load. When the version reaches its ceiling and all operators are idle, the register resets so the grid can keep rebalancing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The amount of served load plus the amount of shed load is always exactly the fixed total demand the grid started with.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m2p2t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS TotalPlayers, MaxCap

VARIABLES pool, reserved, seated, cap, txn
vars == <<pool, reserved, seated, cap, txn>>

TxnStates == {"none", "preparing", "prepared"}

Init ==
    /\ pool = TotalPlayers
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ seated = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ txn = "none"

Prepare ==
    /\ txn = "none"
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ seated + reserved < cap
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ txn' = "preparing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seated, cap>>

Vote ==
    /\ txn = "preparing"
    /\ txn' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, reserved, seated, cap>>

Commit ==
    /\ txn = "prepared"
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ seated' = seated + 1
    /\ txn' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, cap>>

Abort ==
    /\ txn \in {"preparing", "prepared"}
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ txn' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seated, cap>>

LeaveMatch ==
    /\ seated > 0
    /\ seated' = seated - 1
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, cap, txn>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 1 .. MaxCap : c # cap /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, reserved, seated, txn>>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare \/ Vote \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ LeaveMatch \/ ChangeCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SlotConservation ==
    pool + reserved + seated = TotalPlayers

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    TotalPlayers = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INVARIANT SlotConservation
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into a live match using a two-phase commit across the coordinator and the match participants. Player slots are a conserved quantity: every player token is at all times either waiting in the pool, reserved mid-transaction, or seated in the match, and the three tallies always sum to the fixed roster the service started with. To seat a player the coordinator opens a transaction and reserves one player from the pool, provided the match is not already at capacity. The participants then vote; on a yes vote the transaction becomes prepared, and a commit converts the reserved player into a seated player. If the transaction is aborted at any point, the reserved player is rolled back into the pool. A seated player may leave the match and return to the pool, which recycles slots so matchmaking continues indefinitely. The match capacity is not fixed: an operator may raise or lower the seat capacity at runtime, and the conservation of player tokens must hold no matter how capacity changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of players in the pool plus those reserved plus those seated is always exactly the fixed roster total the service started with.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od17m6p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, Bags, MaxClock, LeaseLen

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES holder, leaseEnd, clock, active
vars == <<holder, leaseEnd, clock, active>>

HeldSlots == {s \in Slots : holder[s] # NONE}

Init ==
    /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseEnd = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ active = Slots

Acquire(s, b) ==
    /\ s \in active
    /\ holder[s] = NONE
    /\ \A t \in Slots : holder[t] # b
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = b]
    /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, active>>

Renew(s) ==
    /\ holder[s] # NONE
    /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, active>>

Expire(s) ==
    /\ holder[s] # NONE
    /\ clock > leaseEnd[s]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseEnd, clock, active>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, leaseEnd, active>>

ToggleChute(s) ==
    /\ holder[s] = NONE
    /\ active' = IF s \in active THEN active \ {s} ELSE active \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, leaseEnd, clock>>

Recycle ==
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ holder' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseEnd' = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Next ==
    \/ Tick \/ Recycle
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Renew(s) \/ Expire(s) \/ ToggleChute(s) \/ \E b \in Bags : Acquire(s, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoBagDoubleBooked ==
    \A s1, s2 \in Slots :
        (holder[s1] # NONE /\ holder[s1] = holder[s2]) => (s1 = s2)


================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Slots = {c1, c2}
    Bags = {b1, b2}
    MaxClock = 2
    LeaseLen = 1
INVARIANT NoBagDoubleBooked
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to conveyor chute slots using lease-based ownership with expiry. Each bag may occupy at most one chute slot at a time: when the router acquires a slot for a bag it grants a lease that runs until a future deadline on the router's clock, and the same bag must never end up allocated to two different chute slots simultaneously. A held slot may have its lease renewed to a later deadline while the bag is still routing. As the clock advances, a lease whose deadline has passed expires and the slot is released, freeing the bag to be routed again elsewhere. The set of chute slots that are actually open is not fixed: the router may open or close chutes at runtime as downstream belts start and stop, changing capacity, and bags may only be acquired into currently open chutes. To keep the terminal running around the clock, once the router's clock reaches the end of its horizon it rolls the clock back to the start and clears all outstanding leases so a fresh routing cycle begins.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No single bag is ever allocated to two different chute slots at the same time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od8m6p3t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Seats, MaxClock, LeaseLen

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES registry, held, clock, leaseEnd
vars == <<registry, held, clock, leaseEnd>>

Init ==
    /\ registry = [s \in Seats |-> NONE]
    /\ held = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ leaseEnd = [s \in Seats |-> 0]

Grant(i, s) ==
    /\ registry[s] = NONE
    /\ registry' = [registry EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![i] = held[i] \cup {s}]
    /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Release(i, s) ==
    /\ s \in held[i]
    /\ registry' = [registry EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![i] = held[i] \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseEnd>>

Expire(s) ==
    /\ registry[s] # NONE
    /\ clock > leaseEnd[s]
    /\ registry' = [registry EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ held' = [i \in Instances |-> held[i] \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseEnd>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<registry, held, leaseEnd>>

Recycle ==
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ registry' = [s \in Seats |-> NONE]
    /\ held' = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ leaseEnd' = [s \in Seats |-> 0]

Next ==
    \/ Tick \/ Recycle
    \/ \E s \in Seats : Expire(s) \/ \E i \in Instances : Grant(i, s) \/ Release(i, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoSharedSeat ==
    \A i1, i2 \in Instances :
        \A s \in Seats :
            (s \in held[i1] /\ s \in held[i2]) => (i1 = i2)

RegistryAgrees ==
    \A i \in Instances : \A s \in Seats : (s \in held[i]) => (registry[s] = i)

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    Seats = {x1, x2}
    MaxClock = 2
    LeaseLen = 1
INVARIANT NoSharedSeat
INVARIANT RegistryAgrees
nl:
A university course-registration system runs two independent registration instances, for example a main-campus server and a satellite-campus server, that share one common pool of course seats. Seats are handed out with lease-based ownership: to give a seat to a student, an instance takes a lease on that seat in the shared seat registry, which records which instance now owns it, and the instance adds the seat to its own local set of held seats. Because both instances draw from the same pool, the critical safety concern is that the same seat must never be simultaneously held by both instances. An instance may only take a lease on a seat that the shared registry shows as free, and it releases the seat by clearing the registry entry and dropping the seat from its local set. Leases expire: as the shared clock advances past a lease deadline, the seat is reclaimed from whichever instance held it, clearing both the registry entry and that instance's local record so the seat is genuinely free again. When the clock reaches the end of its horizon it rolls back and all leases are cleared, so registration can run across many enrollment rounds.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No course seat is ever held by both registration instances at the same time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m7p3t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Slots, Units, MaxInbox, MaxVersion

AllRequests == [slot : Slots, unit : Units]

VARIABLES inbox, grants, done, version
vars == <<inbox, grants, done, version>>

Init ==
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ done = {}
    /\ version = 0

Arrive(r) ==

Each pending update carries the version of the enrollment record that the submitting instance read when it prepared the update. Because the queue is bounded, an instance may submit an update only while the queue has room, applying backpressure otherwise. Updates are applied in queue order: the update at the head commits only if the version it was based on still equals the live record version, meaning no other update has been applied since it was read; committing advances the record version and logs the committed update tagged with the resulting version. This base-version check is what guarantees no lost updates even though two instances interleave their submissions. When the version reaches its ceiling and the queue drains, the system resets so registration continues across rounds.
